description:
This repository provides the reproducibility package for the manuscript "Grounding Machine Learning and LLM-Based Risk Inference in a Shared SHACL Knowledge Layer: An NFCRM-1:2025 Case Study."

It contains the implementation and experimental artefacts used to evaluate the proposed knowledge-grounding architecture, including the OWL/RDF cybersecurity knowledge model, SHACL constraint profiles, preprocessing and evaluation scripts, machine-learning and LLM workflows, saved validation and evaluation results, and figure-generation code.

The package supports reproduction and audit of the reported knowledge-layer validation, GRC artefact conformance, schema-comparison experiments, CIC-IDS2018 and NSL-KDD evaluations, and associated ablation and control experiments. Original third-party benchmark datasets are not redistributed and must be obtained from their respective sources where required by their distribution terms.

NFCRM-1:2025 serves as the evaluated regulatory profile. The repository is intended to support transparency, reproducibility, and independent verification of the experimental findings reported in the accompanying article.
